question: How much observed paired-return dispersion comes from the event leg, matched-control leg and their covariance, and how much exact contemporaneous exposure cancellation or reuse is present?
data_role: Do not relabel the 2021-2025 paired Validation ledger as Development. No 2021-2025 prices or return ledgers are read by this runner; no ETF/2026/MO prices. The short STAR50 context is reported with its actual size, not extended to get more data.
signal: Unchanged R1_A generated by the existing certified price-layer engine and thresholds; structural-resolution nonoverlap preserved. No parameter refit.
matching: Reuse build_r1_events_and_controls and match_events unchanged, restricted to each pre2021 scope. Filter to R1_A before matching. This creates a separately labeled Development cohort, never rematches or replaces the old Validation pairs. Same-year, direction, 30min bucket and existing four standardized features, replacement and earliest-index ties preserved. Full-year control selection is retrospective and is NOT an online-available control rule.
end_boundary: Load only through 2020-12-31 and require all 240 future observed bars for cohort membership. No extension into Validation. The common cohort is fixed across seven horizons.
returns: d*(P[entry+h]/P[entry]-1)*10000, simple signed bp; event and control unchanged. No adjusted-alpha mean, p-value, confidence interval, optimized horizon or performance PASS.

variance.normalization: ddof=0 empirical finite-cohort moments, not a claim of IID sampling or estimated long-run variance
variance.shares: Report signed contributions divided by V(E-C), and covariance cancellation relative to V(E)+V(C). Negative and above-100pct terms stay visible; undefined ratios are null.
variance.tail_diagnostic: Share of centered squared deviation in largest ceil(1pct*n) and ceil(5pct*n); no trimming or modified return target.

strata.identity: empirical total covariance = weighted within-stratum covariance + covariance of stratum means, using n_g/n
strata.interpretation: Retrospective accounting of heterogeneity, not achievable causal variance reduction; retain singleton/low-count strata rather than hide them.

clock_accounting.exact_mean_representation: Each pair's simple return is the sum of price increments divided by its entry price. Aggregate signed event and control weights on the same observed minute clock and keep all calendar days including zero exposure. Mean E-C is exactly reproduced without log/simple approximation.
diagnostics: signed vs unsigned elementary-shock weight-square ratio
daily contribution event/control variance and covariance
centered daily lag cross-products at lags 0,1,5,20,60
clock_accounting.limits: Weight-square ratios refer only to hypothetical independent equal-variance elementary minute-return shocks. Daily and lag products are descriptive contribution accounting, not SE estimates, selected bandwidths or tests of market dependence. Same index on different days is NOT the same realized shock.

control_scale_scenarios.assumptions: Use observed Development marginal Ve/Vc only. Explicitly set event-control noise covariance to zero and impose exchangeable control noise for these hypothetical comparisons. Not a fitted model, not an attainable bound for actual R1_A, not a change of matching or payoff.

budget: One unchanged cohort per scope, seven horizons, stated tables only; no repeated estimator sweep, new factor search, nuisance prediction model, optimized matching, expanding dates or iterative thresholds. Stop after accounting and interpretation.
interpretation: Observable variance/covariance and exposure bookkeeping, not identification of latent economic shocks, irreducible noise, causality or uncertainty of the mean. A small/no covariance or low control variance may rule out simple control averaging as the main improvement within stated assumptions; it never proves zero alpha. Means needed for centering are not repurposed into a new significance claim.
